Name: Cute Pink Albino Bunny Recolor
Author: jirachi77
Description:
Cute pinkish white albino bunny recolor of the original rabbit. Only the colors and the eyes have slightly changed. Perfect for a kawaii and adorable farm~!!

1. Unpack .rar file
2. Back up Rabbit.xnb found in StardewValley/Content/Animals
3. Replace Rabbit.xnb found in that same place ^^^ with the new one from the .rar file
4.  Enjoy this cute bunny <3
